about:
In La Apparel operates from Los Angeles and Orange County, California, as a vertically integrated apparel manufacturer focused on made-in-USA production. The company runs two factories, including a knitting mill in the Los Angeles fashion district, and employs a small team to manage design, development, and production for private-label clients.

The company provides full-service private-label manufacturing covering design consulting, pattern making, grading, marking, cutting, sewing, fabric and garment dyeing, printing, embroidery, sublimation, heat transfer, and specialty decorations such as deboss, burnout, and reflective transfers. Its in-house knitting mill produces fabrics in cotton, synthetic, viscose/modal, polyester, melanges, organic, and slub yarns, while also offering organic and sustainable options. Production scales from low-minimum-order samples to large-volume runs, with packaging and fulfillment handled on-site.

Clients span the fashion industry, corporate and uniform programs, promotional products, and entertainment production studios creating costumes for motion pictures, commercials, and television. The company works directly with independent designers, established brands, and artists, offering end-to-end development from concept through retail-ready shipment.

In La Apparel differentiates itself through a sweatshop-free, vertically integrated model that keeps all manufacturing domestic, emphasizing customer service and quality control at every stage. The firm highlights its 'Organic Zone' for 100% organic apparel, fast turnaround times, and the ability to process orders of any quantity, positioning itself as a one-stop partner from fabric development to final delivery.
